identificationModule.officialTitle: Choice of Topotecan or Melphalan in Retinoblastoma Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate topotecan and melphalan for retinoblastoma patients.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: To evaluate the effectiveness and complications of topotecan and melphalan for intraocular injection in retinoblastoma patients.

interventions.name: Topotecan
interventions.description: Topotecan intraocular injection for chemotherapy in retinoblastoma

interventions.name: Melphalan
interventions.description: Melphalan intraocular injection for chemotherapy in retinoblastoma

primaryOutcomes.description: Eyeball-sparing rate during chemotherapy in retinoblastoma patients

secondaryOutcomes.description: Side effects during and after chemotherapy in retinoblastoma patients

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosed as retinoblastoma
* receiving eyeball-sparing treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* disease progression during follow-up
